name: table_sources
purpose: Investigation only (nothing changed in the corpus): structured versions of the report tables, and the cost of re-extracting flagged tables with a vision model.

structured_sources.checked: 2026-11-23, bank investor pages and web search

ing_group_pillar3_2025.file: 2025 ING Groep NV appendices additional Pillar III disclosures (.xlsx, 0.97 MB)

mapping_estimate.method: EBA template code (EU XXn) found in the table caption, first two rows or section title, compared with the sheet names (read with the standard library: zip + XML)
mapping_estimate.caveat: template-level match only; cell-level alignment not checked

socgen_pillar3_2025_en.note: no Pillar 3 xlsx in search results; the investor document base needs a category filter ('Pillar III and other prudential publications') to be checked by hand

bnpp_fortis_pillar3_2025.note: financial reports page returned HTTP 503 twice; search found PDFs only

structured_sources.dependency: reading cells needs openpyxl (3.1.5 is installed in the venv but not declared; needs approval) or a stdlib zip + XML reader (no dependency, more code: shared strings, merged cells)

vision_reextraction.model: Mistral OCR (document OCR API; returns Markdown/HTML tables per page)
vision_reextraction.price_checked: 2026-11-23: $4 per 1,000 pages (OCR 4.x, standard); older OCR versions $1-2 per 1,000 pages
vision_reextraction.dependency: none required: httpx (declared) can call the REST API; the mistralai SDK would be optional. Needs MISTRAL_API_KEY in .env
vision_reextraction.data_leaving_the_machine: raw report pages (public bank documents, unmasked) are sent to the API
vision_reextraction.status: not called (no paid API call without approval)
